title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 50 ]

items.text: He said to me, "I love you."
He told me that he loved me.
He said to me, "I loved you."
He told me that he had loved me.
He said, "I saw him steal the money yesterday."
He said that he had seen him steal the money the day before.
He said, "Alexander conquered the Persian Empire."
He said that Alexander conquered the Persian Empire.
I know the president accepted the Secretary's suggestion that he convene the summit in Washington.
Japan's officials sought to protect drug companies from competition, failing to prevent the spread of HIV among hemophiliacs.
